front-sb2-notch.prompt: Ultra-premium product photograph of a luxury bespoke suit for a high-end international tailoring house (Savile Row / Neapolitan quality), in the style of the best online made-to-measure configurators. Invisible-mannequin (ghost mannequin) presentation: the jacket is shown as if worn by an invisible athletic body, with real three-dimensional volume - softly padded natural shoulders with a clean roped sleeve-head, a full chest, the lapels rolling in a gentle unpressed curve, the waist suppressed, the skirt of the jacket flaring slightly over the hips, the sleeves hanging naturally slightly forward with a gentle bend at the elbow. The neck opening shows the inside back collar and the lining in the SAME colour as the suit cloth (tonal satin lining). Straight-on front view, camera at chest height, orthographic feel, perfectly centred and symmetrical. Below the jacket, the matching trousers are folded in half lengthwise and laid at a very slight angle, waistband to the right, the hem folded back at the left, showing a flat front with a sharp crease, belt loops, a side pocket and one jetted back pocket with a button. CLOTH: a fine Italian Super 120s worsted wool in a plain neutral mid grey (#9A9A9A) with a subtle, visible fine twill weave and a soft natural lustre - rich and expensive, never flat, plasticky or cheap. Hand-finished details: pick-stitched lapel edges, a lapel buttonhole, real horn buttons with depth and sheen, clean welt breast pocket. BACKGROUND: seamless very light neutral warm-grey (#F2F1EE), no gradient, no vignette. LIGHTING: soft, large diffused studio light from the front-top, gentle natural shading that reveals the cloth's volume and drape, a faint soft contact shadow only. Tack-sharp, photorealistic, 2K detail, no text, no logos, no hanger, no visible mannequin, no person, no props. STYLE DETAILS: single-breasted two-button jacket, fastened on the top button, notch lapels 8.5 cm wide, two straight flap hip pockets, four kissing cuff buttons on each sleeve. The jacket occupies the upper 62% of the frame and the folded trousers the lower 30%.

fabricSwatch.template: Editorial product photograph for a bespoke tailor's fabric library: a generous length of DESC, softly folded over on itself in one loose, rounded fold, lying on a plain warm cream paper surface. The cloth fills most of the square frame, running diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, with a little cream background visible in one corner. Close, intimate framing (about 20 cm of cloth visible) so the weave and pattern read clearly at their true scale. Soft natural window light from the left, gentle shadow inside the fold, shallow depth of field with the front of the fold tack-sharp. True, rich colour close to HEX. Medium-format, photorealistic, quiet luxury mood, no text, no logo, no props.
fabricSwatch.note: Flat top-down texture prompts were refused ('Image recitation block'); the folded composition matches the existing fabric photos.

onModel.note: First prompt makes front-sb2-notch; every other pose is an edit of that first image in the same conversation. Save as design/model-src/<pose>.jpg, then python3 scripts/build-model-poses.py.

prompts.front-sb2-notch:
Professional full-length e-commerce fashion photograph for a luxury bespoke tailoring house, shot in a high-end studio. A tall, athletic Black man stands perfectly straight facing the camera in a neutral catalogue pose: arms relaxed and hanging at his sides slightly away from the body so the jacket sides stay visible, hands open near the thighs, feet slightly apart. Framed from just below the chin (the face is NOT shown; the crop is at the chin) down to just below the shoes, the figure exactly centred and filling the full height of the frame.
He wears a beautifully tailored single-breasted two-button suit with notch lapels, fastened on the top button, two straight flap hip pockets, a welt breast pocket, four kissing cuff buttons, dark horn buttons, slim tailored trousers with a sharp centre crease and a clean half break, black polished oxford shoes, a crisp white dress shirt and a long silk tie.
COLOUR CODING - this is critical, for our digital fabric system, colours must be exactly these, uniform and flat (no pattern, only a subtle fine wool weave, with realistic folds and soft shading): the JACKET is medium BLUE (#4A6FA5); the TROUSERS are medium GREEN (#4F8A55), clearly a different colour from the jacket; the TIE is solid bright MAGENTA (#D0208F). Shirt pure white, shoes black, skin natural.
BACKGROUND: seamless plain light neutral grey (#EDEDED), no gradient, soft even studio lighting from the front, a faint soft contact shadow under the shoes only. Photorealistic, tack sharp, luxury quality, no text, no logos, no props.
